args.body: Continue with one distribution deliverable: inspect products/distribution/invoice-preflight-review.zip and bundle-manifest.json, then prepare a channel-specific submission draft with cited current channel rules, an explicit price hypothesis and a measurable response criterion. Save it under products/distribution/. Do not repeat absent-account probes, invent a contact/payment destination, or claim submission. Coordinate with the INVOICE-IDEA-VERDICT mission before adding platform claims. Public listing requires an independent reviewer from another provider/turn and the exact digest; resident role names alone do not satisfy that requirement.

description: Prepare a reviewable distribution bundle, extract existing demand evidence for an explicit idea verdict, and record the known hosting blocker. No spending or publication is claimed.
